author: Charles S
title: Top highlight of our time in Lisbon.
text: I highly recommend the Portuguese Wine and Food Experiences through Enrico and Sip Wine Tours.   My family of eight adults thoroughly enjoyed his 3-hour Walking Food and Wine tour.  We visited three small, family-run restaurants during the tour.  Each venue had amazing food prepared and ready to serve as we arrived, along with several fantastic wine pairings at each place. (During the tour booking process, Enrico even ensured that each venue prepared one gluten-free and one vegetarian dish to accommodate two of our family members).  Enrico took great care in explaining each dish and thoroughly described the various wine pairings.  Throughout the night, we had entertaining conversations with Enrico on wine, food, culture, and history. Enrico is passionate about food, wine, and Lisbon, and loves to impart that passion to his guests.  He has a breadth of knowledge that he gladly shared throughout the evening, along with his engaging personal stories.  By the end of the evening, not only did we have a very memorable experience, but I felt like we gained a new friend in Enrico.  This tour was one of the top highlights of our week in Portugal.

author: MimiT
title: A must do, fabulous.
text: We were given Enrico’s name from our tuk tuk guide. It was a last minute booking and Enrico was very flexible by doing the tour with us in the evening.  He was very easy to communicate with, stayed in touch and made it easy to meet. Enrico is a joy. His infectious smile,  presence and warmth made him feel like a friend than guide.  It was obvious he had a great working relationship with the restaurant owners. The selection of wines was fabulous. White in the first restaurant  and red in the second.  The food choices were perfect. The pace was relaxed. Lots of great conversation and laughter. We lingered over the food and wine. There was none of the stop watch timing of other tours, in fact we went over our time. As we strolled through the Alfama district Enrico was a tour guide, pointing out sites of interest.  Alfama in the evening  is magical. In the second restaurant, A Muralha, while sitting there the owner was cooking up veal sandwiches with garlic for other customers. The aroma was mouthwatering. Enrico asked the owner to make one up for us, which he did. There was more than enough wine and food to satiate. Thank you Enrico for helping create fabulous memories.

author: FlaFoodandWiney
title: Highlight of our Lisbon visit- Enrico knows his food and wine- experience like a local.
text: The highlight of our visit to Lisbon was experiencing this food and wine tour with our educated guide Enrico. We were paired with one other couple from the US who became quick friends with our shared passion for food and wine. We met at the oldest restaurant in Lisbon right off the main city square. Enrico sent advanced text making it easy to connect in our meeting spot. He brought two bottles of white wine for us to taste along with some appetizers at the restaurant at our private outdoor table. From there, we walked into a charming local neighborhood we would have never found on our own. Enrico clearly knew the owners, and from there, he opened 3 bottles of stellar red wines and they began bringing plates of Portuguese cuisine for us to sample. It was more food and wine than the four of us could finish. We shared laughs and life stories about travel/food/wine from our travels around the world. The evening ended with our 87-year-old maker (in pictures) who had us sample her homemade Ginjinha (a Portuguese liqueur made by infusing ginja berries in alcohol). She served them in eatable chocolate shot cups. What an experience, and unexpectedly delicious. Thank you, Enrico, for making the connection with Kelen and Marcelo who live in NJ. We had so much fun our evening with you, we reconnected in Porto for another two dinners together. Your recommendation of Manels was the highlight of our culinary dinners in Porto. This tour is worth every penny and more. Please support Enrico by booking this tour as you will not be disappointed. He speaks fluent English, and you will experience Lisbon like a local. Thank you, Enrico, for being the highlight of our trip to Lisbon!
